title: Contact Out Front (Michelle Grogan)
style: funk-rnb-reggaeton-cumbia-dnb fusion 132bpm slap bass Rhodes sax horns dembow marimba guiro congas dnb chorus beatbox claps English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Intro]
Contact in front contact in front
Let the ball come to you not back
Early read early step
Meet the ball where you can see

[Verse 1]
Eighteen inches in front of the chest
Thats the contact point at best
If the ball is past the body line
Defense only no design
Vamos vamos meet it early
Uno dos tres meet it surely
Split step on their swing
Feet pop and you can sing

[Pre-Chorus]
Meet it early
Meet it sure
Meet it early
We endure

[Chorus]
Contact out front contact out front
Meet the ball meet the ball
Contact out front contact out front
Vamos amigos meet it all

[Verse 2]
If it gets past the front line
Reset only no design
Recover and breath count three
Next one comes and we agree
Uno dos tres watch the seam
Mano firme paddle in the beam
Predict the ball before they swing
Contact early is the king

[Bridge]
Late contact is the loser
Eighteen inches early is the user
Breath count three reset eyes
Next ball next ball your prize

[Chorus]
Contact out front contact out front
Meet the ball meet the ball
Contact out front contact out front
Vamos amigos meet it all

[Outro]
Meet it early
Eighteen inches
Meet it early
Eighteen inches
